# Travel Off Script

> > Travel Off Script is a solo and female travel resource featuring city guides, budget accommodation, transportation tips, and destination itineraries across Europe, Asia, and Latin America.

The site specializes in practical travel advice for independent travelers, with a focus on safe solo female travel, budget-friendly options, and detailed guides to destinations like Japan, Vietnam, Peru, Greece, and Mexico. Content includes accommodation recommendations, transportation logistics, and curated itineraries for major cities and off-the-beaten-path locations.

## Key Topics

- Solo female travel
- Budget travel
- City guides
- Travel safety
- Japan (Kyoto, Osaka, Nara)
- Vietnam (Hanoi, Sapa)
- Europe destinations
- Budget hostels
- Airport transfers
- Peru travel
- Mexico (Cancun)
- Greece
- Transportation guides
- Accommodation recommendations
- Travel itineraries
